title: The Cheap Flat
intro: You are looking for a flat in Pune. One listing is far cheaper than the rest.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Flat is yours if you send the deposit today…

screen.context: You found his listing on a rental site. You have not seen the flat.

msg: Hello! The 2 BHK is available at
, so I cannot show it myself.
now by phone transfer and I will courier you the keys.

msg.text: Three other families are asking. Pay in one hour or I give it away.
Photos attached: bright rooms, new kitchen.

rent.label: Rent far below the area
rent.why: A rent far below nearby flats is the bait.

abroad.label: Owner is "abroad"
abroad.lens: He cannot meet you or show the flat.
abroad.why: Scammers are always somewhere else. Never pay for a place you have not seen.

deposit.label: Deposit before viewing
deposit.lens: He wants ₹20,000 before you see the flat or sign anything.
deposit.why: Pay only after seeing the place and signing a proper agreement.

rush.label: Hurry or lose it
rush.lens: Pay in one hour or it goes to someone else.
rush.why: A rush is a pressure trick to stop you checking.

photos.label: Nice photos
photos.lens: Bright rooms and a new kitchen.
photos.why: Photos are copied from other listings. They prove nothing.

actions.label: Ask to see the flat in person, or search the address

block_report.line: Reported the listing. The rental site removed it before it fooled anyone else.

verify.line: A search of the address showed the same photos in three other ads under different names. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The ₹20,000 went to a stranger. No keys came, the number went dead, and the flat belonged to someone else.

what_if.go_ahead: Insisting on seeing the flat first would have ended it. A real owner understands.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Never pay a deposit for a place you have not seen. A very cheap rent plus "I am abroad" is the pattern.

quick_check.q: A very cheap flat. The owner is abroad and wants a deposit today before you can visit. What is the best move?

options.text: Pay quickly before it is gone
Only go ahead after seeing it in person and signing an agreement
Ask him to send more photos

quick_check.explain: Never pay for what you have not seen. That alone settles it.

hints.nudge: Where is the owner, and what does he want before you see the flat?

rows.k: A deposit before you see the place

rows.v: Search the address and the owner's name, and visit in person
